findings: Deep narrow septal Q waves in lateral leads

echoTasks.find: Asymmetric septal thickening with a small cavity and no systolic anterior motion at rest
Enlarged left atrium with diastolic dysfunction and no systolic anterior motion
Papillary muscle level short axis without apical aneurysm or crypts

auscultation.added: Fourth sound from the stiff ventricle
auscultation.murmur: Soft ejection systolic murmur grade 2 of 6 that eases with squatting

exam.general: Well 34 year old woman, no distress, athletic build
exam.other: No oedema, lungs clear, blood pressure normal

history.a: Atypical chest ache on exertion for a year, no syncope, no palpitation
Brother diagnosed with a familial heart muscle condition at 28, father carries the gene
No hypertension, no diabetes, no drugs
Runs 5 km thrice weekly without symptoms
Wants risk clarity before a second pregnancy
First echo at a referral camp last week

keyPoints: Confirm the diagnosis at a cardiomyopathy centre with MRI for fibrosis and aneurysm assessment
Risk stratify for sudden death with Holter, exercise testing and family review before advising on sport
Start a beta blocker or calcium channel blocker if symptoms or diastolic burden warrant it
Screen all first degree relatives and offer genetic counselling through the referral centre
Counsel on pregnancy, which is usually well tolerated without obstruction, with joint cardiac obstetric review
management.model: Referral centre confirmation with MRI, formal risk stratification, family cascade screening, and pregnancy counselling

sources: ACC and AHA guideline on hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, in own words
ASE chamber quantification guideline, in own words
stem: A 34 year old woman from Delhi with a brother recently diagnosed with a familial heart muscle condition presents for family screening with mild exertional chest ache.
teaching: Definite means wall 15 to 19 mm with resting gradient below 30 mmHg
Deep septal Q waves with voltage LVH in a family member is the classic screening ECG
Diastolic dysfunction with an enlarged atrium drives symptoms without obstruction
Cascade screening of the whole family follows every new definite diagnosis
title: Non obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy on family screening
